job_positions.title: ICU / Critical Care Registered Nurse
job_positions.description: Provide high-acuity critical care management, ventilator monitoring, and rapid emergency intervention in a state-of-the-art Level 1 trauma facility.
job_positions.requirements: Active RN license, BLS, ACLS, NIHSS required. Compact license accepted. CCRN preferred.

job_positions.title: Emergency Department Staff Nurse
job_positions.description: Manage triage, acute medical crisis assessments, pediatric and adult trauma resuscitation, and coordinate bedside care.
job_positions.requirements: Active TX/Compact RN license, BLS, ACLS, PALS, TNCC preferred.

job_positions.title: Operating Room (OR / Surgical) Nurse
job_positions.description: Circulate and scrub for orthopedic, general, vascular, and robotic minimally invasive surgical cases.
job_positions.requirements: RN License, BLS, ACLS, CNOR preferred. Experience with DaVinci Xi robotic systems a plus.

job_positions.title: EHR Specialist & Clinical Informatics Consultant
job_positions.description: Lead clinical workflow integration, optimize Epic / Cerner EHR workflows for nursing staff, and oversee deployment training.
job_positions.requirements: Epic or Cerner Certified, Clinical background (RN/BSN/Informatics) highly preferred.

job_positions.title: Cardiovascular Interventional Radiographer
job_positions.description: Assist interventional cardiologists in diagnostic and therapeutic cardiac catheterizations, stenting, and pacemaker insertions.
job_positions.requirements: ARRT (R) or RCIS certification, BLS, ACLS.

job_positions.title: Medical-Surgical / Telemetry Float Nurse
job_positions.description: Provide inpatient nursing coverage across acute med-surg and telemetry units with cardiac rhythm strip interpretation.
job_positions.requirements: Active NC/Compact RN license, BLS, ACLS.
